messages.subject: How to pass A Factor as input to mapreduce function
parts:
Hi,

I am new to rmr and mapreduce programming paradigm in general. I am having issues while passing a factor as an input to mapreduce function which further processes it for Polarity check. My code (in brief) is as follows :
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
f<-hdfs.read.text.file("/home/data/pmo_1429685700930")
post_comments = read.table(textConnection(f), sep = "|",blank.lines.skip = T,allowEscapes = T, quote = "" ,fill=T)
data <-post_comments$V4 #A factor with 2300 Levels

sentiment.map<-function(k,v) {  
  unlist(mapply(classify_polarity,v,algorithm="bayes"))[seq(4,4*length(v),4)]   #The classify_polarity function (computes polarity), is defined and is working properly when I checked it without using rmr/mapreduce
}

result<- mapreduce(input=data, map=sentiment.map)
return(result)
--------------------------------------------
I know I just can't pass a factor like that to map function. I need to define "input.format" parameter along with make.input.format(if necessary). I am just unable to figure out how to do that. Any other workarounds for acheiving this?

Have been struggling with this. Any leads or help will be appreciated.

Thanks,
Saheb
